description: July 21 birthday meaning: Cancer or Leo cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, July 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Cancer or Leo. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a July 21 birthday
paragraphs: Approaching the Leo cusp, July 21st usually keeps the Sun in the late degrees of Cancer, but birth year and time decide it for sure. The blend is often described as heart on display: the Moon's tenderness beginning to borrow the Sun's confidence. With 3 as the birthday number, expression comes naturally, especially performing, hosting or telling family stories.

By noon UTC on July 21, the Sun has normally reached roughly 28° of Cancer. That places the date in the Cancer decan that astrologers give to Neptune, the third of three. Around July 21 to July 23, the Sun moves from Cancer, a water sign, into Leo, a fire sign. Born near that line, your Sun sign hangs on the exact year, time and birthplace, because the crossing does not happen at the same moment each July. A chart cast for your details will settle which side you are on. Astrologers often say people on this cusp combine lunar sensitivity with solar warmth and confidence. That blend can look like a protective host: someone who wants to be seen, and wants everyone in the room to feel safe.

sections.heading: Numerology of the July 21 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same July 21 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: July 21 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 21 is the 202nd day of the year (203rd in a leap year). In most years Leo season is under way by July 23, 2 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. July 21 is also the birthday of Ernest Hemingway (1899), Robin Williams (1951) and Erling Haaland (2000).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 21?
faq.answer: July 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Cancer or Leo on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Cancer. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 21 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 21?
faq.answer: By July 21 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 21?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a July 21 birthday are Ernest Hemingway (1899), Robin Williams (1951) and Erling Haaland (2000). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
